actions: flexes the PIP joints of toes 2-5

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Central muscle of the first plantar layer, its 4 tendons each splitting (like FDS in the hand) to allow the corresponding flexor digitorum longus tendon to pass through en route to the distal phalanx -- the foot's structural analog of flexor digitorum superficialis.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse at the mid-plantar aspect of the foot.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: First (most superficial) plantar muscle layer; the quadratus plantae lies immediately deep to it at this level.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Appears as an oval superficial muscle mass superficial and medial to the cuboid and superficial and lateral to the navicular.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: The source describes an in-plane needle approach (preferred over out-of-plane) so that the FDB2, FDB3, FDB4 and FDB5 slips can each be targeted at their point of maximal thickness in a single pass, reducing the number of skin punctures. Injected for spastic hallux/lesser-toe claw-toe, claw-foot and equinus/equinovarus patterns. No specific intramuscular neural-arborization percentage is given for this muscle in the source (unlike flexor hallucis brevis, reported separately in the same paper).
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 (https://doi.org/10.3390/toxins17100508) -- retrieved via PubMed
